# Support

## Questions

Usage questions are best asked in the [Pact Foundation
Slack](https://slack.pact.io) or on [Stack
Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/pact), where more people
will see them.

## Documentation

- [pact-go documentation](https://docs.pact.io/implementation_guides/go)
- [Pact documentation](https://docs.pact.io)
- [Examples](https://github.com/pact-foundation/pact-go/tree/master/examples)

## Bugs

Open an [issue](https://github.com/pact-foundation/pact-go/issues/new/choose)
with a reproducible example.
